headline: High: Aci can egress broadly into Notion workspace data, creating default-path leakage and action-conflict risks; prompt-injection and cascading-error risks are lower but real.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Aci can ingest and act through MCP/direct function calls, while Notion AI is RAG-style over workspace content and can surface page text. If Aci writes or summarizes attacker-controlled content into Notion pages, B may later treat that content as trusted workspace context. The shared workspace channel makes injection plausible, though not proven by docs alone.
conditions: IF Aci writes attacker-controlled text into a Notion page that Notion AI later summarizes or answers from
IF the workspace content is used as instruction-bearing input without provenance checks
mitigations: Add a visible provenance banner to AI-generated pages
Restrict Aci writes to a dedicated staging workspace
Require human review before Notion AI consumes newly written pages
Use page templates that separate instructions from content
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging and filtering

B_data_leakage.rationale: Aci has broad network egress and touches email, CRM, calendar, and support data; Notion AI is vendor-hosted and can access workspace pages/databases. If sensitive CRM or email data is copied into Notion, B can transmit it to vendor backends and downstream model providers. The pair therefore creates a default-path leakage risk across both agents.
conditions: IF Aci writes CRM, email, or support data into Notion workspace pages
IF Notion AI processes those pages through vendor backends or downstream model providers
mitigations: Keep sensitive CRM/email data out of Notion pages
Use a redaction step before copying Aci outputs into Notion
Limit Notion AI to non-sensitive workspaces
Review workspace sharing and retention settings
requires-engineering: enforce data-class-based routing

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Aci supports multiple instances and can call external APIs; Notion AI also supports multiple instances and shares workspace state across members. Even though Notion AI cannot write the host filesystem, both agents can mutate shared Notion content, so concurrent edits can conflict in default collaborative use. The overlap is narrower than unrestricted filesystem writes, but still material.
conditions: IF Aci and Notion AI edit the same workspace page or database concurrently
IF no external locking or review workflow serializes their writes
mitigations: Assign separate pages for each agent
Use a single-writer workflow for shared documents
Pause one agent during bulk edits
Add manual merge review for concurrent changes
requires-engineering: implement optimistic locking on shared pages

D_cascading_error.rationale: Aci can generate CRM/email/calendar actions, and Notion AI can ground answers in workspace content. If Aci's output is copied into Notion and then reused as authoritative context, B may propagate errors into summaries or downstream decisions. The pair lacks a documented verification boundary, so the cascade is plausible in default collaborative workflows.
conditions: IF Aci-produced text is pasted into Notion pages used as source material
IF Notion AI answers or drafts actions from that content without human verification
mitigations: Mark Aci outputs as unverified drafts
Require source links for claims before reuse
Have a human verify summaries before publication
Separate raw inputs from decision pages
requires-engineering: add verification gates between agents

E_compliance.rationale: Aci touches email, CRM, calendar, and support data, while Notion AI is vendor-hosted and processes workspace content through Notion and downstream model providers. If regulated or retention-sensitive data is copied into Notion, the pair can create a policy mismatch even without a specific residency violation. The profiles do not prove a HIPAA/GDPR breach, so medium is the higher justified level.
conditions: IF regulated customer data is stored in Notion pages processed by Notion AI
IF the workspace retention or deletion policy differs from the source system
mitigations: Avoid placing regulated data in Notion
Apply retention labels before copying content
Document which data classes may enter Notion
Review workspace export/delete procedures
requires-engineering: align retention and residency controls
